snippet.title: The Ghost Cage trailer
snippet.description:
Winner of the Spooktober Spooktacular Game Jam in 2020!

The Ghost Cage is a short and light-hearted adventure game where you decide how to deal with a ghost. Download for free now on Itch.io or wishlist it on Steam (release date: Oct 2021)!

Itch.io: https://seaphoenix.itch.io/the-ghost-cage
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719130/The_Ghost_Cage/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/SeaPhoenixGames
Game developer: SeaPhoenix
Music: J.C. Brickston
